summary: Azul S.A. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) updating procedures regarding subscription warrants related to its Chapter 11 restructuring plan. The Company requested B3 to cancel warrants credited to investors subject to the restructuring plan restrictions and all warrants from secondary-market rights exercises. Azul will directly reimburse amounts paid for these disregarded rights, simplifying the process via a single email request. This is a capital-returns event as it involves canceling and reimbursing subscription warrants, effectively returning capital to affected investors. The filing provides no financial terms, deadlines, or advisors; watch for investor response and B3's action on cancellations.
